title: FutureBench: A Renewable Framework for Evaluating Knowledge-Context Conflict in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.23601v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Asking a model to check retrieved text can also tell it which source to trust. We introduce FutureBench, a renewable framework for evaluating knowledge-context conflict using timestamped questions, controlled passage triplets, and no-context probes. Across 3,629 questions and six models, Verify (a prompt combining checking with passage priority) raises false-answer adoption in all five models tested on pre-cutoff events, mainly by displacing answers that were correct under Baseline, which allows both passage evidence and model knowledge. On post-cutoff events, only o4-mini increases adoption (+13.7 percentage points). A four-prompt comparison on 902 post-cutoff questions finds that passage priority without checking raises adoption, while moving to Verify lowers it in all five models. Adversarial-Aware, which warns of misleading passages and prioritizes model knowledge, restores 82.5-98.9% of displaced pre-cutoff answers with under one

translated_title: FutureBench：一个用于评估大语言模型知识-上下文冲突的可再生框架
translated_abstract: 要求模型检查检索到的文本，同时也可能告诉它应该信任哪个来源。我们提出FutureBench，一个使用带时间戳的问题、受控段落三元组和无上下文探针来评估知识-上下文冲突的可再生框架。在3,629个问题和六个模型上，Verify（一种结合检查与段落优先级的提示方法）在截止日期前事件上测试的所有五个模型中都提高了错误答案的采纳率，主要是通过替换掉在Baseline（允许同时使用段落证据和模型知识）条件下原本正确的答案。在截止日期后的事件上，只有o4-mini提高了采纳率（+13.7个百分点）。在902个截止日期后问题上进行的四种提示对比发现，不含检查的段落优先级会提高采纳率，而转向Verify则在所有五个模型中都降低了采纳率。Adversarial-Aware（会警告存在误导性段落并优先考虑模型知识）恢复了82.5-98.9%被替换的截止日期前答案。
tldr: FutureBench是一个利用时间戳问题评估大语言模型知识与检索上下文冲突的可再生基准，研究发现“检查+段落优先”提示会增加模型采纳错误答案的倾向，而具有对抗意识的提示可以恢复大部分被替换的正确答案。
en_tdlr: FutureBench is a renewable benchmark that uses timestamped questions to evaluate knowledge-context conflict in LLMs, revealing that "verify with passage priority" prompts increase false-answer adoption while adversarial-aware prompts restore most displaced correct answers.
